mapper.select: select ${fn}(cast(#{ctx} as jsonb), cast(#{a} as jsonb))::text
select data from lms_media_obj where media_id = cast(#{mid} as uuid) and path = #{path}
select data from lms_file where file_id = cast(#{id} as uuid)
select store from lms_media_obj where media_id = cast(#{mid} as uuid) and path = #{path}
mapper.insert: insert into lms_media_obj (tenant_id, media_id, path, mime, size, store, data) values (current_setting('app.tenant'), cast(#{mid} as uuid), #{path}, #{mime}, #{size}, #{store}, #{data,jdbcType=BINARY}) on conflict (tenant_id, media_id, path) do update set mime = excluded.mime, size = excluded.size, store = excluded.store, data = excluded.data
mapper.select: update lms_media_q set status = 'running', locked_at = now(), worker = #{worker} where job_id = (select job_id from lms_media_q where status = 'queued' or (status = 'running' and locked_at < now() - interval '30 minutes') order by created_at limit 1 for update skip locked) returning job_id::text as job_id, tenant_id, kind
mapper.delete: delete from lms_media_q where job_id = cast(#{job} as uuid)
mapper.select: select id from tenants where type = 'univ'
